cards.target: Aluga-se sala comercial.

cards.target: Aqui não se pode estacionar.
cards.english: You can't park here.

cards.target: É necessário que se faça um registro.
cards.english: It's necessary to make a formal record.

cards.target: É proibido entrar sem autorização.
cards.english: Entry without authorization is prohibited.

cards.target: As vagas foram preenchidas rapidamente.
cards.english: The positions were filled quickly.

cards.target: Vê-se que ele está preocupado.

cards.target: Em outras palavras, estamos falidos.
cards.english: In other words, we're broke.

cards.target: O projeto foi aprovado por unanimidade.
cards.english: The project was approved unanimously.

cards.target: Ele viajou apesar de estar doente.
cards.english: He traveled despite being sick.

cards.target: Nada obstante, o resultado foi satisfatório.
cards.english: Notwithstanding, the result was satisfactory.

cards.target: Ao passo que uns trabalham, outros descansam.
cards.english: While some work, others rest.

cards.target: Além do mais, a comida estava excelente.
cards.english: Furthermore, the food was excellent.

cards.target: Vive-se bem nesta cidade.
cards.english: One lives well in this city.

cards.target: Trabalha-se demais no Brasil.
cards.english: People work too much in Brazil.

cards.target: É importante respeitar as regras.
cards.english: It's important to respect the rules.

cards.target: Ao invés de brigar, conversem.
cards.english: Instead of fighting, talk it out.

cards.target: A lei foi aprovada pelo congresso.
cards.english: The law was approved by congress.

cards.target: A carta foi escrita à mão.
cards.english: The letter was written by hand.

cards.target: Em resumo, precisamos de mais investimento.
cards.english: In summary, we need more investment.

cards.target: Não obstante as dificuldades, a empresa cresceu.
cards.english: Notwithstanding the difficulties, the company grew.

cards.target: No entanto, nem tudo é tão simples.
cards.english: Nevertheless, not everything is that simple.

cards.target: Ela costumava tomar café da manhã cedo.
cards.english: She used to have breakfast early.

cards.target: É difícil encontrar vaga de estacionamento no centro.
cards.english: It's hard to find parking downtown.

cards.target: Posto que todos concordaram, vamos seguir em frente.
cards.english: Since everyone agreed, let's move forward.

cards.target: A decisão foi tomada pelo conselho.
cards.english: The decision was made by the board.

cards.target: A ponte foi inaugurada pelo prefeito.
cards.english: The bridge was inaugurated by the mayor.

cards.target: A festa foi organizada pelos funcionários.
cards.english: The party was organized by the employees.

cards.target: Os prêmios foram distribuídos aos vencedores.
cards.english: The prizes were distributed to the winners.

cards.target: A proposta foi rejeitada pela maioria.
cards.english: The proposal was rejected by the majority.

cards.target: É indispensável apresentar comprovante de residência.
cards.english: It's essential to present proof of residence.

cards.target: Ainda por cima, ele chegou atrasado.
cards.english: On top of that, he arrived late.

cards.target: Nesse sentido, o governo tomou providências.
cards.english: In that regard, the government took measures.

cards.target: Acabei de ler um livro incrível.
cards.english: I just read an incredible book.

cards.target: O prédio foi construído nos anos cinquenta.
cards.english: The building was built in the fifties.

cards.target: O contrato foi assinado pelas duas partes.
cards.english: The contract was signed by both parties.

cards.target: O evento foi patrocinado por várias empresas.
cards.english: The event was sponsored by several companies.

cards.target: A obra foi concluída antes do prazo.
cards.english: The construction was completed before the deadline.

cards.target: Os alunos foram avaliados por uma banca.
cards.english: The students were evaluated by a panel.

cards.target: É fundamental manter a calma em emergências.
cards.english: It's essential to stay calm in emergencies.

cards.target: A música foi composta por Tom Jobim.
cards.english: The song was composed by Tom Jobim.

cards.target: O filme foi dirigido por Fernando Meirelles.
cards.english: The movie was directed by Fernando Meirelles.

cards.target: Enquanto eu cozinho, você arruma a mesa.
cards.english: While I cook, you set the table.

cards.target: O professor sugeriu que lêssemos aquele livro.
cards.english: The teacher suggested we read that book.

cards.target: Ele é simpático, todavia nem sempre é sincero.
cards.english: He's nice, however he's not always sincere.

cards.target: Em particular, o setor de tecnologia teve destaque.
cards.english: In particular, the technology sector stood out.

cards.target: A escola foi fundada em mil novecentos e sessenta.
cards.english: The school was founded in nineteen sixty.

cards.target: Já que você está aqui, me ajuda com isso.
cards.english: Since you're here, help me with this.

cards.target: Constrói-se muito nesta região.
cards.english: Much is built in this area.

cards.target: É preciso ter paciência nessa situação.
cards.english: It's necessary to be patient in this situation.

cards.target: Percebe-se que o clima está mudando.
cards.english: You can see that the climate is changing.

cards.target: Acredita-se que a vacina será eficaz.
cards.english: It's believed that the vaccine will be effective.

cards.target: Assim que eu chegar, te ligo.
cards.english: As soon as I arrive, I'll call you.

cards.target: Além disso, precisamos contratar mais gente.
cards.english: Besides that, we need to hire more people.

cards.target: Isto é, precisamos rever o orçamento.
cards.english: That is, we need to review the budget.

cards.target: Assim sendo, não temos outra escolha.
cards.english: That being so, we have no other choice.

cards.target: Acabei comprando mais do que precisava.
cards.english: I ended up buying more than I needed.

cards.target: Ela anda comendo muito fast food.
cards.english: She's been eating a lot of fast food.

cards.target: O relatório foi elaborado pelo departamento financeiro.
cards.english: The report was prepared by the finance department.

cards.target: Espera-se que a situação melhore em breve.
cards.english: It's expected that the situation will improve soon.

cards.target: Tanto faz se ele vem ou não.
cards.english: It doesn't matter whether he comes or not.

existing_tips: 'Até onde eu sei' + indicative – states speaker's knowledge.
'Deixar de' + infinitive = to stop/quit doing something.
'Parar de' + infinitive = to stop doing something.
'Desde que' can mean 'since' (time) or 'as long as' (condition).
'Diz-se que' – impersonal way to express hearsay/rumor.
